stable.notes: A queued message opens to its whole text on the pet card, and can be edited while it waits: Edit puts it in the field, Return replaces it, Escape keeps it as it was; the Sessions pane has Edit and Replace. A message the session already has cannot be replaced, and Control says so. Includes 0.5.235 (queue listed and cancellable) and 0.5.234 (message a session from the pet, queue-and-deliver, 12-hour meeting times).

notice.title: Queued messages open and edit
notice.body: Tap a queued row on the pet card to read the whole message. Edit puts it in the field; Return replaces it in the queue, Escape keeps it as it was. The Sessions composer has Edit and Replace. With more than one waiting, the edited message goes to the back of the line, and Control says so. A message the session already has cannot be recalled.
